_comment: Club names for scripts/sync-domestic-clubs.mjs, keyed by EFEM/FM clubId. fm is FM's current name (the sync stops when FM renames the club). With name/short, FM's unlicensed placeholder is replaced and kept as fmName/fmShort in the snapshot; without them the FM name is genuine and only clears the all-capitals placeholder check. Add a replacement only when the club behind the placeholder is certain.
